caption: The drawing depicts a detailed architectural rendering of a pedestal or base structure, with a curving profile that narrows at the center and widens toward the top and bottom. The main body of the structure is illustrated in earthy tones of beige, tan, and light brown, with shading in gray and blue hues to indicate depth and contour. There is a circular medallion at the center front of the structure, within which is a sunburst-like emblem featuring alternating red and blue rays emanating from a red central circle. Architectural dimensions and notations in black ink surround the drawing, specifying various heights, widths, and other measurements. The pedestal rests on a wide, rectangular base drawn in a matching color palette, and the entire illustration is set against a plain, off-white background with some brown stains and aged marks. Additional technical line drawings below the main illustration provide further measurements and sectional views, and the name "Wm. Heffman" is written in black ink just beneath the main colored drawing. The indicated scale is 3 inches equals 1 foot.
title: Baptismal Font
